documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management reported robust growth in quarterly revenue and profitability driven by manufacturing scale-up, backward integration, and operational efficiency. The company aims to scale manufacturing utilization to 100% by the end of FY2027 and increase manufacturing contribution to 50% of its revenue mix. Furthermore, the management remains focused on expanding its product portfolio into non-textile industries and reducing debt using strong internal cash flows. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial and operational performance for Q4 FY26 and FY26, highlighting a transition from a trading model to manufacturing following the commissioning of its Vadodara facility.

guidance.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA margin can increase by 200 to 300 basis points overall.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: Management targets 50%-50% contribution from trading and manufacturing respectively.
guidance.quote: Right now, . Like it is in trading and manufacturing right now what we did as of now was 75%-25% that will become 50%-50% .

guidance.claim: Trading business growth for the year is expected to be stable or around 10% to 20%.
guidance.quote: So basically, this year we are prioritizing manufacturing only. So, for trading we can expect stable or 1% to 2%.

guidance.claim: Trading growth is expected to be 10%-20% while focus remains on manufacturing.
guidance.quote: 10%-20% growth, but the focus will continue to be on manufacturing for this year.

guidance.claim: Management maintains its expectation of closing the year around INR 110 crores in top-line revenue.
guidance.quote: Prateek Chaudhary: Sir, in our last con call, we had said that this year we would close around INR110 crores. So are you still maintaining that guidance or has something changed? Tushar Sanghavi: No, of course the same. These two months, January and February, have also gone well for us.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a lot of awareness to get out of solvents in the market looking to the global situation and pressure from the government.
demand_outlook.quote: Because now, there is a lot of awareness to get out of solvents in the market. Looking to the global situation as well as the pressure from the government.

demand_outlook.claim: People are looking for solvent-free solutions, leading to very good business as a domestic player.
demand_outlook.quote: So, people are looking for solvent-free solutions. And where we are getting very good business as a domestic player.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted improving demand trends in the wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects growth of 15% to 20% in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% in the wood coating market.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: A new branch was opened at Kochi 3 months before which is a good manufacturing hub for furniture.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, 3 months before, we have been opened a branch at Kochi which is a very good manufacturing hub for the furniture.

capex_expansion.claim: Further capacity expansion can be done by putting up vessels costing INR3 crore to INR5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Our company has successfully commenced production at its a 72,000 sq ft state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the company's first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: Proactive inventory strategy has helped secure raw materials at favourable blended costs to provide margin stability over the near term.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment and 12% to 15% for the trading business.
margins_costs.quote: When we compare specifically for, comparison with manufacturing and trading business, we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Fixed costs have completely set in and absorption is at 60% capacity.
margins_costs.quote: And all our costs have completely set in like all the fixed costs have already been incurred in the setting up of the factory, right. So now the absorption of the cost is only at 60% capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Management aims to reduce costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and internal efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Reducing costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies in logistics, inventory, and processes.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The product portfolio includes 128 textile printing inks and 70 wood coating polymer products.
orders_capacity.quote: • Silkflex offers a diverse portfolio of 128 textile printing inks and 70 wood coating polymer products.

orders_capacity.claim: The newly commissioned manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization reached around 60% in the first two months of operation.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The long-term term loan stands at INR 30 crores and working capital stands at INR 20 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores. Nidhi, can you hear me?

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to scale manufacturing utilization and reach full capacity by the end of FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to increase the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of the revenue mix in FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to launch new products from R&D trials within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months to expand the product portfolio and enter adjacent categories.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to selectively expand market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment.
management_commitments.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve full capacity utilization by the next financial year based on market demand.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
